title: Salamanderplatz, Kornwestheim
description:
Kurzinformationen zu den Wohnungen

4-Zimmerwohnung im 3. OG (Haus 3) mit gehobener Ausstattung wurde 2019 gebaut.  Die Wohnung wurde komplett   modern   eingerichtet und bietet viel Platz bis zu 4 (hidden) ist komplett ausgestattet und verfügt über 3 Schlafzimmer, 1 Wohnzimmer/ Küche mit Esszimmer, 1 Bad mit Tageslicht, 1 Dusche , 1 Abstellraum , Kellerraum, Fahrradraum, Garage. title: Albstraße, Kornwestheim
description:
It is a one-bedroom, one-bed apartment with an en-suite bathroom with a shower or bath. 
There is also a fully equipped kitchen with fridge and freezer compartment. A coffee maker, kettle and toaster are available in the room. 
The bed linen and towels are provided by us and changed as part of the two-week cleaning. 
The room has a flat screen TV and WiFi, which is available free of charge.

Location:

The apartments are a minute's drive from the B27, which provides good connections to many parts of Stuttgart or to Ludwigsburg. The apartments are also a one-minute walk from the Albstraße bus stop. Kornwestheim train station can be reached by bus within 10 minutes, which offers direct S-Bahn connections to Stuttgart or Ludwigsburg.

General information:
- These are non-smoking apartments, smoking is only allowed in front of the building
- All apartments have a fully equipped kitchen
- Toaster, coffee maker and kettle available
- There is a shared washing machine and dryer available in the building. The costs are €2 per load.
- Parking spaces are provided free of charge, subject to availability.
- All rooms have a flat screen TV
- WIFI is available free of charge
- The rooms are cleaned every 14 days. The cleaning fee is included in the price.
- Pets are not allowed

Please be aware that HousingAnywhere is an online booking platform. Therefore exchanging contact details and offering viewings is not possible. If you would like to reserve this accommodation, send me a booking request or a message and please mention your age and occupation. I look forward to meeting you!
